questions.question: Guru Debaprasad Das Awardee Durga Charan Ranbir is a teacher and performer of which of the following classical dance forms?
questions.solution: Durga Charan Ranbir is a prominent teacher and exponent of Odissi classical dance. He is a senior disciple of the legendary Guru Debaprasad Das and is known for carrying forward the Debaprasad Gharana, which incorporates elements of tribal and folk traditions into the classical structure.

questions.question: Who among the following founded the ‘Kalakshetra’ in 1936, an Indian arts academy that was especially dedicated to the cultivation of the Bharatanatyam tradition?
questions.solution: Rukmini Devi Arundale founded Kalakshetra in 1936 in Chennai. She was a visionary who reimagined Bharatanatyam, removing its social stigma and establishing a formal curriculum that emphasized spiritual and aesthetic purity.

questions.question: Mallika Sarabhai is the most famous Indian dancer renowned for ____.
questions.solution: Mallika Sarabhai, daughter of Mrinalini and Vikram Sarabhai, is a world-renowned dancer accomplished in both Kuchipudi and Bharatanatyam. She is also a social activist who often uses her dance to address contemporary social issues.

questions.question: In 1976, Natya Tarangini, was founded in the National Capital Region, by world renowned Kuchipudi Dance duo ___________.
questions.solution: The world-renowned Kuchipudi dance duo Raja and Radha Reddy founded Natya Tarangini in 1976. They are credited with bringing Kuchipudi to the international map through their high-energy, synchronized performances.

questions.question: L Bino Devi, Sangeet Natak Akademi Award winner had received the award for his contribution to which of the following dances forms?
questions.solution: L. Bino Devi was honored by the Sangeet Natak Akademi for her significant contribution to Manipuri dance. She is specifically recognized for her expertise in Leima Jagoi and other traditional forms of the Meitei community.

questions.question: Kalamandalam Rajan received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2009 for which of the following dance forms?
questions.solution: Kalamandalam Rajan is a distinguished performer of Kathakali. He received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 2009 for his excellence in this Kerala-based dance-drama, particularly for his mastery of vachika (verbal expression) and abhinaya.

questions.question: Which of the following is the correct pair?
questions.solution:
Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma is correctly paired with Mohiniyattam. She is often called the 'Mother of Mohiniyattam' for her role in reviving the dance.
Note: Shovana Narayan (Kathak), Sonal Mansingh (Odissi/Bharatanatyam), and Bala Saraswati (Bharatanatyam).

questions.question: Ms. Kamalini Asthana and Ms. Nalini Asthana are conferred with one of the top highest civilian awards of India, Padma Shri 2022. Which of the following dance forms of Banaras Gharana are they known for?
questions.solution: The sister duo Nalini and Kamalini Asthana are exponents of Kathak belonging to the Banaras Gharana. They were awarded the Padma Shri in 2022 for their efforts in popularizing the temple-style traditional aspects of Kathak.

questions.question: EM Subramaniam was an exponent of the ________, a musical instrument.
questions.solution: E.M. Subramaniam was a celebrated virtuoso of the Ghatam (an earthen pot instrument) in Carnatic music. He was known for his incredible speed and rhythmic complexity, often accompanying the greatest legends of South Indian music.

questions.question: Which of the following is the youngest percussionist to be awarded Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan awards by the Government of India?
questions.solution: Ustad Zakir Hussain is the youngest percussionist to receive both the Padma Shri (1988) and Padma Bhushan (2002). He is a global icon of the Tabla and was later honored with the Padma Vibhushan in 2023.

questions.question: Mame Khan is an Indian playback and folk singer from ________.
questions.solution: Mame Khan is a famous playback and folk singer from Rajasthan. He belongs to the Manganiyar community and is known for blending Rajasthani folk music with contemporary genres, gaining fame through 'Coke Studio'.

questions.question: The Nooran Sisters are renowned for which of the following genres of Indian Music?
questions.solution: The Nooran Sisters (Jyoti and Sultana Nooran) are famous for the Sufi genre of music. They hail from the Sham Chaurasia Gharana and are known for their powerful, high-pitched vocal style popularized in Bollywood and live concerts.

questions.question: Who is the first Indian musician to win the Oscar award for Best Original Score?
questions.solution: A.R. Rahman was the first Indian musician to win the Oscar (Academy Award) for Best Original Score for the film Slumdog Millionaire (2009). He also won a second Oscar for the song 'Jai Ho' in the same year.

questions.question: Who among the following is credited with single-handedly making the Santoor a popular classical instrument?
questions.solution: Pandit Shiv Kumar Sharma is the musician credited with single-handedly transforming the Santoor from a 100-stringed Kashmiri folk instrument into a globally respected Indian classical instrument.

questions.question: Pandit Ravi Shankar, a music legend is famous for which of the following styles of music?
questions.solution: Pandit Ravi Shankar was a global ambassador of Hindustani classical instrumental music. A maestro of the Sitar, he won five Grammy awards and the Bharat Ratna for his contribution to music.

questions.question: Tulsidas Borkar, who was awarded with the Padma Shri in 2016, was a _________ player.
questions.solution: Tulsidas Borkar was a legendary Harmonium player who received the Padma Shri in 2016. He was known for his unique techniques in solo harmonium playing and for modifying the instrument to better suit Indian classical music.

questions.question: Pandit Bhimsen Guracharya Joshi was an Indian classical vocalist born in ___________.
questions.solution: Pandit Bhimsen Joshi, the legendary Hindustani vocalist of the Kirana Gharana, was born in Gadag, Karnataka. He was awarded the Bharat Ratna in 2008 and is famous for his powerful, soulful voice.

questions.question: Rajeev Janardan is an Indian classical __________ player of the Imdadkhani gharana.
questions.solution: Rajeev Janardan is an eminent Sitar player belonging to the Imdadkhani Gharana (also known as the Etawah Gharana). This gharana is famous for its Gayaki Ang, which mimics the nuances of the human voice on the sitar.

questions.question: __________ was first trained in classical music under her father Ustad ‘Baba’ Allauddin Khan, and established the Maihar-Senia gharana with his help.
questions.solution: Annapurna Devi (born Roshanara Khan) was a master of the Surbahar (bass sitar). She was the daughter of Ustad Allauddin Khan and played a pivotal role in the Maihar-Senia gharana, though she chose to remain reclusive for most of her life.

questions.question: Hariprasad Chaurasia is associated with which of the following instruments?
questions.solution: Pandit Hariprasad Chaurasia is a world-renowned maestro of the Bansuri (bamboo flute). He is credited with bringing the flute to the forefront of Hindustani classical music as a lead solo instrument.

questions.question: Who among the following is a famous violinist?
questions.solution: Nagai R. Muralidharan is a highly respected Violinist in the Carnatic music tradition. He is known for his technical mastery and for accompanying legendary vocalists across the globe.

questions.question: Pandit Bhawani Shankar is a ________ player.
questions.solution: Pandit Bhawani Shankar is a distinguished master of the Pakhawaj, a barrel-shaped, two-headed drum used primarily in the Dhrupad style of Indian classical music. He is often referred to as the 'Pakhawaj Samrat'.

questions.question: Ustad Zakir Hussain, Ustad Allah Rakha, Ustad Sabir Khan, Pt. Kishan Maharaj are known for which of the following instruments?
questions.solution: Ustad Zakir Hussain, Ustad Allah Rakha, Ustad Sabir Khan, and Pt. Kishan Maharaj are all legendary exponents of the Tabla, representing different gharanas like Punjab, Farrukhabad, and Benaras.

questions.question: Mohanan Chandrasekaran, an awardee of Madras Music Academy's Sangeetha Kalanidhi, is a __________ player of Carnatic classical music.
questions.solution: M. Chandrasekaran is a legendary Violin player of Carnatic classical music. A recipient of the Sangeetha Kalanidhi, he is famous for his unique playing style and for his ability to sing while playing the violin.

questions.question: Ustad Amir Khan belonged to which of the following Gharanas?
questions.solution: Ustad Amir Khan was the founder of the Indore Gharana. He was one of the most influential vocalists of the 20th century, known for his meditative, slow-tempo (Vilambit) development of ragas.
